name: Umbral-UNITE: An Immersive Journey Through the History of Nursing. Un Recorrido Inmersivo por la Historia de la Enfermería.
summary: Welcome to the Virtual Laboratory of Nursing History, developed within the framework of the European UNITE project. This immersive space invites you to walk, first-hand, through different settings that reconstruct the evolution of the nursing profession over time: from its roots in medieval monastic care to its consolidation as a scientific and humane discipline within contemporary healthcare. Bienvenido/a al Laboratorio Virtual de Historia de la Enfermería, desarrollado en el marco del proyecto UNITE.
